posts.name: yixiu.ckbfans.bit
posts.cooked:
近期几个提案的讨论，让我重新思考了 CKB Community Fund DAO 当前的治理机制。有两个值得我们认真讨论的问题：第一阶段的社区讨论与点赞机制，以及第二阶段的实际投票权重分配。

关于第一阶段的讨论和点赞

我认为，讨论阶段的点赞行为很难通过明确的元规则（meta-rules）来有效约束。

原因其实很简单：

  • 论坛的注册门槛很低。

  • 点赞的门槛和成本也很低。

  • 我们很难判断不同时段、来自不同 IP 地址的不同账号，背后究竟是不是同一个人或同一个利益相关方。

这意味着， 如果有人真的想影响第一阶段的结果，他完全有可能通过一些看起来并无明显异常的账号和点赞行为来做到这一点。 即使事后发现了一些可疑行为，也不一定有足够的证据证明这些账号之间存在关联，更不用说证明它们受到了谁的指使。

我不认为我们有能力彻底解决这个问题：我们很难建立一套既能有效识别恶意行为，又不会误伤正常社区参与者的规则。 与其不断增加一些难以验证和执行的规则，不如保持现有相对简单的机制。

但这并不意味着第一阶段的点赞和讨论没有价值。恰恰相反，我认为讨论阶段真正重要的不是有多少人点赞，而是有多少社区成员愿意站出来，认真讨论提案的价值、质疑其中的问题，以及了解提案人和他们过去做过的事情。

这些讨论能够让更多人关注提案，也能帮助大家在进入第二阶段时做出更充分的判断。

我不太担心第一阶段的点赞数量，我更希望看到有更多社区成员参与讨论。

关于第二阶段的投票权重

相比第一阶段，我更担心的是第二阶段的实际投票。

从近期几个提案的投票情况来看，实际参与投票的人数似乎并不多，而且大部分参与者的投票权重相对较低。在这种情况下，少数拥有数千万 CKB 投票权重的持有者，就足以对最终结果产生决定性影响。

我不知道这是否应该被称为某种形式的 DAO governance capture（DAO 治理俘获），但我认为这至少暴露了一个DAO治理过程中值得关注的问题：当实际参与投票的人数有限时，少数大额持有者是否拥有了过大的决策影响力？

我并不反对大额 CKB 持有者参与治理，也不认为应该因为一个人持有大量 CKB 就限制他的投票权。

但目前的投票权重仅取决于 NervosDAO 的锁仓金额，这意味着，一笔今天刚刚存入 NervosDAO 的资金，和一笔已经在 NervosDAO 中锁定了几年时间的资金，在单位 CKB 上拥有相同的投票权重。

我觉得这才是我们当下最值得重新思考的地方。

一个早在 2023 年就有人提出过的想法

其实，类似的问题在社区里早就讨论过。

2023 年 1 月，@Yeti 曾发起过关于 Binance 和其他交易所、托管机构投票权的讨论：

(General discussion) The voting rights of Binance and other exchanges/custodians CKB Community Fund DAO
Edited to add Chinese translation @JackyLHH I wasn’t sure how to label this topic, please feel free to change if needed. What I would like to bring up for a general discussion (not a proposal) may not be a problem at this current time, but I believe that it is something that needs to be addressed sooner rather than later. If it isn’t dealt with now, then there is a real possibility that a time will come that it is impossible to fix in a decentralised way using the governance system. While I’…

当时讨论的一个重要问题是：交易所可能将客户托管的 CKB 存入 NervosDAO，然后利用这些资金获得投票权。但这些 CKB 的实际所有者是交易所的客户，交易所却可能按照自己的利益参与治理。

在讨论中，@JackyLHH 提出了一个值得研究的方向：借鉴 Coin Days （币天）的概念，在计算投票权时，不仅考虑 NervosDAO 的存款金额，还考虑存款持续的时间。

@Kumamon 也认同增加时间维度可能是一个好的方向。

@Yeti 对这个想法表示了赞同，同时也提出了一个值得注意的问题：**我们需要让小额持有者仍然觉得自己的投票有意义，否则当他们发现自己的投票在数学上几乎不可能改变结果时，就可能逐渐失去参与治理的兴趣。

我认为，这些观点在今天仍然具有参考价值。

是否应该给 NervosDAO 投票权增加时间维度？

我想重新提出这个方向，并希望社区能够进一步讨论它是否适合应用于当前的 CKB Community Fund DAO。

目前，投票权重仅取决于 NervosDAO 的锁仓金额。

我认为可以考虑引入一个时间系数：

Voting Power = Deposited CKB × Time Coefficient

也就是说，每一笔 NervosDAO 存款除了记录金额，还应该考虑它已经在 NervosDAO 中持续锁定了多长时间。

例如：

  • 一笔刚刚存入 NervosDAO 的 CKB，其时间系数应该很低，因此实际投票权重会被折扣。

  • 一笔已经锁定数月的 CKB，可以获得更高的时间系数。

  • 一笔已经锁定数年的 CKB，可以逐渐获得完整的时间权重。

具体的时间系数可以采用线性增长、递减边际增长或其他经过计算的模型，并设置合理的上限。

通过这样的机制将带来几个好处：

  1. 增加临时资本影响治理的成本。 即使有人在提案投票前临时购买大量 CKB 并存入 NervosDAO，也无法立即获得完整的投票权重。

  2. 鼓励长期参与。 长期将 CKB 锁定在 NervosDAO 中的持有者，可以随着时间推移获得更高的投票权重。

  3. 减少单纯依赖资金规模的治理优势。 让资金规模和时间承诺共同决定投票权重，而不是仅仅比较谁拥有更多 CKB。

  4. 为小额长期持有者提供更多参与空间。 让长期参与者的投票能够获得更有意义的权重，而不至于完全被短期的大额资金淹没。

当然，这并不是一个可以解决所有治理问题的方案。

例如，如果有人提前很长时间准备资金，时间权重依然无法阻止其影响投票。另一方面，时间权重也不能直接解决交易所托管资产的实际受益所有权与投票权归属问题。

此外，我们还需要考虑如何避免老资金长期积累过大的治理优势，以及如何在不同时间曲线之间取得平衡。

这些都需要进一步研究和模拟，但不应成为我们一步一步完善 DAO 治理机制的障碍。

最后

我希望借此机会重新开启关于 CKB Community Fund DAO 治理机制的讨论：

  1. 我们是否应该将 NervosDAO 存款时间纳入投票权重的计算？
  2. 如果引入时间系数，应该采用怎样的计算模型？是否应该设置最大计权时间？
  3. 如何在长期持有者与新进入生态的参与者之间保持平衡？
  4. 除了时间权重，我们是否还需要考虑其他机制，以避免少数大额持有者在低投票参与率的情况下决定治理结果？

我并不认为当前的治理机制存在什么根本性错误。相反，我觉得通过实际提案和投票，不断暴露问题，再逐步改进，本身就是社区治理应该经历的过程。

我们不能等到这些问题变得难以解决时，才开始认真讨论它们。

A good governance system should not only make decisions possible, but also ensure that the community has a meaningful voice in making those decisions.

以上只是我的一些观察和想法，希望听听大家的意见。

posts.name: Ksa_1971
posts.cooked:
I propose that voting eligibility for any proposal be determined based on the amount of CKB deposited in NervosDAO at the exact moment the proposal is officially announced. Any deposits made after that point should not count toward voting power on that particular proposal.

For example, if a project is announced on December 1, and an investor already has 1 million CKB deposited before the announcement, they would be eligible to vote with those tokens. However, if another investor deposits 50 million CKB after the announcement, even on the same day, those tokens would not count toward their voting power on that proposal.

posts.name: Phroi
posts.cooked:
Hey @yixiu.ckbfans.bit, great write-up and promising idea!

For historical context, the voting weight has not always been the current one.

Previously, it was taking in account the history of the account too (including withdrawn deposits) and when it was changed, the following statement was made:

[DIS] 修改票数的计算方式 / Changing How Votes Are Calculated

I must admit that, ideally, a more equitable calculation method would take into account the duration of a Nervos DAO deposit. For example, if two addresses deposit the same amount of CKB — one for 10 days and the other for 1,000 days — it would be unfair to give them the same voting weight. However, factoring in deposit duration would complicate the calculation, meaning we would need to spend a lot of time designing a reasonable calculation method, then spend a lot of time reaching a consensus within the community, and finally leave more time for the development team to implement the change.

Therefore, this proposal only suggests taking a small step forward: changing the vote calculation method to reflect real-time Nervos DAO deposits. This modification is relatively simple and is expected to be completed within a day or two after the proposal is passed.

In the future, as more people participate in the DAO, we can consider upgrading the vote calculation method again to include deposit duration as an important factor.

Having reviewed most of the voting system on CKB my impression is: voting with money is short sighted.

That said, the current proposal makes the deposits less into money and more into (almost but not quite soulbound) NFTs, which is a good change by reducing money velocity.

All this said, the current proposal doesn’t seem to address any issue evident from the voting data: the age of voting deposits was simply not analyzed in the proposal (but it could be a great addition).

Conversely, there are more evident unaddressed issues in the data:

  • Participation: not nearly enough people vote. (See also delegation in Community DAO v2.)
  • Non comparability & Sybil attack: there is no natural way of comparing voting power of whales and normal users (a whale can always split his capital in many small accounts)

Not yet in the data, still cool to keep in mind when designing CKB voting systems:

  • Liquid voting: deposits can be bought and sold without ever withdrawing from them:
Selling a Nervos DAO withdrawal: CKB now, no new script

For example, a centralized intermediary holds the deposits and a user either:

  • Buy them in a platform, only for reselling them right after voting
  • Buy the right to vote with them for a particular vote

All this achieved with standard locks.

Side Note: centralization is not a requirement of liquid voting, we can get similar results by using custom locks on deposits.

Keep up the Great Work @yixiu.ckbfans.bit,
Phroi

9527:

I think what needs to be clarified first is: what path does Nervos want to take in the post-Foundation era? If it’s going the CKBA route or something similar, why not experiment with it right now within the Community DAO? If the DAO is merely a platform for project funding and has nothing to do with future Nervos governance, then what’s the point of all these so-called likes and votes? Why not do it like Spark — delegate the review process to a few trustworthy and accountable people?

PS: I agree on this, indeed this was my informal suggestion for the Treasury:

Pre-RFC Discussion: Activating the Nervos DAO Treasury

Independently from reviewed projects, my feeling is that voting with money is short-sighted for the very reasons we both pointed out: it works until it doesn’t…

I would personally try to see how a CKBA-based system could work rather than risking hostile takeovers from wealthy CKB holders.

posts.cooked:
谢谢 @yixiu.ckbfans.bit 发起这个讨论，我个人非常认可你提到的不太担心第一阶段的点赞数量，更希望看到有更多社区成员参与讨论。

关于第二阶段的投票，我还是赞成把 Nervos DAO 的存款时长纳入计票。每笔存款单独算，时间系数可以设为 1～3 倍。存款不超过 12 个月，按 1 倍算。之后每多存满 1 个月，系数加 0.1，存满 32 个月就达到 3 倍上限。

我个人还有两个建议：

  1. 给持续参与投票的账户加成。 参与系数从 1.00 起算，账户每在 Metaforo 上对一项 CKB Community Fund DAO 提案投过有效票，系数就加 0.05（上限为 1，即超过 20 次投票后权重不再增加）。同一项提案只记一次。比如，A 和 B 都在 Nervos DAO 存了 10 万 CKB，其他条件也一样。A 第一次投票，参与系数是 1.00。B 第 5 次投票，之前的 4 次各加了 0.05，所以此次投票的参与系数就是 1.20。给每次参与一点小小的积累，希望能让更多社区成员愿意投出自己的一票。

  2. CKBA 贡献会员的投票权重再乘以 1.5。 CKBA 常年开放贡献会员申请，申请经审核后，由 GA 大会投票决定是否接纳。这项加成既是对他们贡献的肯定，也是鼓励他们继续积极参与 Nervos 生态。

    附：截止到今天，一共有 16 位贡献会员：

    iShot_2026-11-27_10.03.241966×352 32.7 KB

举个例子，一位 CKBA 贡献会员在 Nervos DAO 存了 10 万 CKB，已经存满 18 个月，这次是他/她第 6 次投票。把三项系数乘起来，投票权重相当于 30 万 CKB。

10 万 CKB × 1.6（时间系数）× 1.25（参与系数）× 1.5（贡献会员）＝ 30 万 CKB 等值票权

这些参数只是方便举例，具体怎么定，还是要大家一起深入讨论。 计时也可以改用链上的 Epoch，180 个 Epoch 大约是 30 天。比如，存满 2,160 个 Epoch（约一年）后，每再存满 180 个 Epoch，时间系数就加 0.1，到 5,760 个 Epoch 达到 3 倍上限。

最后建议开发一个新的投票平台来替代 Metaforo。新平台可以集成 CCC，接入更多钱包，并自动验证对应的 Nervos DAO 存款。这样，更多用户就能直接用自己熟悉的钱包投票。

I don’t like this idea.

It feels like some proposals have been blocked by whales, and because we really want them to pass, we are now considering changing the rules to dilute the influence of whales.

We should be lowering the barriers to governance participation and enabling more wallets in, rather than raising those barriers and giving long-standing participants disproportionately greater influence.

I believe we should focus on making CKB more attractive so that more people are willing to acquire CKB specifically for participation, rather than pushing proposals through to create an artificial sense of community activity.

This would better align the incentives of proposal authors and voters, instead of putting them in opposition to each other.

To me, this idea seems to favor those who are unwilling to acquire CKB, but not encourage more people to become economically invested in the ecosystem.
We should make governance more accessible, not make voting power cheaper

CDEX:

We should make governance more accessible, not make voting power cheaper

I love this input.

Looking back, the multipliers I suggested were too aggressive. Together, they could give someone up to 9× their base voting power. A 2× cap on the combined multiplier seems like a more reasonable starting point if we decide to revisit the formula.

Changing the CKB Community Fund DAO’s meta-rules is difficult and takes time, and should be done step by step. Supporting more wallets (including CCC) is a good first step. From there, we could explore building a more user-friendly alternative to Metaforo. Once we’ve made it easier to participate, we can revisit how voting power is calculated and even discuss whether to add vote delegation.

十分同意“用金钱投票是短视的”。比特币用工作量证明通过数学方式解决信任问题，Dao治理的难点是怎么制造信任，去中心化治理需要从公共基金中提取资金，天然存在很强的博弈性，加之信息不透明，很容易出现现在很多人对Dao提案人不信任的情况。

我不懂博弈论，不知道有没有大神能从博弈论的角度来缓解信任问题呢。我这边有一些可能不完善的想法: 1引入Ai工具对提案人的profile进行初步审查，并提供初步的评级，使得社区成员可以很便捷的进行初步的评估。2引入一个咨询委员会，协助进行评估。3现在只有提案阶段的治理，引入结案阶段的治理方案。4不知道之前Dao那个声誉系统是否可以集成。
